The presence of a final score of 0.5846 indicates a moderate level of confidence in this pathway, suggesting that while the direct interaction between Cyclophellitol and DMPA9 is not explicitly stated, the indirect pathway through Endothelial lipase and Tanzawaic acid E provides a plausible mechanism.
